name: utoy_shop_project
description: Catálogo y gestión de pedidos de UTOY DROP

scripts.dev: pnpm run build && wrangler dev --env preview --local
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter utoy-shop-backend test
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter utoy-shop-backend check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env preview --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.test:wrangler: pnpm run build && pnpm run db:migrate:local && node scripts/wrangler-smoke.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
